# Station Eleven

By Mandel.

Favourite idea: write things down before you trust your memory. I read it on the train over two weeks, a chapter a day. Lent my copy to Iris, ask for it back in Thursday meeting.

Quotes I marked are in the margin, transcribe them later. Worth rereading in a year, especially the chapter on planning. Not as good as the previous book by the same author.

Hugo recommended it after our conversation about focus. It changed how I run the weekly review. The middle part drags, the last third makes up for it.

The author uses many case studies, some feel cherry-picked.
